author: Priya Nair
comment: The pink tulip and daisy bouquet was delivered safely to Mumbai. My mother placed it on her living room shelf and everyone thinks they are real flowers until they touch the soft milk cotton!

author: Aditya Kulkarni
comment: Ordered the strawberry bunny plushie for my daughter's 5th birthday. The chenille velvet is so soft and the stitching is super tight. Packaging came with a cute handwritten note!

author: Meera Sundaram
comment: The Daisy Market Tote bag is so well constructed. The cotton lining inside prevents any sagging even with my water bottle and iPad inside. Love AanuBlooms!
